criteria.label: PVS1
criteria.description: Null variant in a gene where LOF is a known mechanism of disease
criteria.pre_compute_hint: Frameshift, stop_gained, or canonical splice variant

criteria.label: PVS1_RNA
criteria.description: Splicing impact confirmed by RNA analysis or predicted by SpliceAI

criteria.label: PS1
criteria.description: Same amino acid change as a previously established pathogenic variant
criteria.pre_compute_hint: ClinVar: known (likely) pathogenic at same AA position

criteria.label: PS2
criteria.description: De novo (confirmed) in patient with the disease and no family history

criteria.label: PS3
criteria.description: Well-established functional studies show a damaging effect

criteria.label: PS4
criteria.description: Prevalence of variant in affected individuals significantly increased over controls

criteria.label: PM1
criteria.description: Variant in mutational hot spot or critical functional domain without benign variation

criteria.label: PM2
criteria.description: Absent or very low frequency in population databases (gnomAD)
criteria.pre_compute_hint: gnomAD AF absent or < gene MTAF threshold

criteria.label: PM3
criteria.description: Detected in trans with a pathogenic variant (for recessive disorders)

criteria.label: PM4
criteria.description: Protein length change due to in-frame indels or stop-loss variants

criteria.label: PM5
criteria.description: Novel missense at same codon where different missense change is pathogenic
criteria.pre_compute_hint: ClinVar: different (likely) pathogenic missense at same codon

criteria.label: PM6
criteria.description: Assumed de novo (without confirmation) in patient with disease

criteria.label: PP1
criteria.description: Co-segregation with disease in multiple affected family members

criteria.label: PP2
criteria.description: Missense variant in gene with low rate of benign missense and disease caused by missense

criteria.label: PP3
criteria.description: Computational evidence supports a damaging effect (REVEL ≥ 0.7 per ACGS 2024)

criteria.label: PP4
criteria.description: Patient phenotype/family history highly specific for gene-specific disease

criteria.label: BA1
criteria.description: Allele frequency > 5% in population databases (or gene-specific MTAF for CanVIG genes). Standalone benign.

criteria.label: BS1
criteria.description: Allele frequency greater than expected for disorder
criteria.pre_compute_hint: gnomAD AF elevated above moderate threshold

criteria.label: BS2
criteria.description: Observed in healthy adult with full penetrance expected at early age

criteria.label: BS3
criteria.description: Well-established functional studies show no damaging effect

criteria.label: BS4
criteria.description: Lack of segregation in affected family members

criteria.label: BP1
criteria.description: Missense variant in gene where truncating variants are the mechanism

criteria.label: BP2
criteria.description: Observed in trans with pathogenic variant in dominant gene, or in cis with pathogenic in any pattern

criteria.label: BP3
criteria.description: In-frame deletions/insertions in repetitive region without known function

criteria.label: BP4
criteria.description: Computational evidence suggests no impact on gene or gene product (REVEL ≤ 0.4)

criteria.label: BP5
criteria.description: Variant found in case with alternative molecular basis for disease

criteria.label: BP7
criteria.description: Synonymous variant with no predicted splice impact and gene has no splice function constraint

criteria.label: BP7_RNA
criteria.description: No predicted splicing impact by SpliceAI for a variant near a splice site

combination_rules.message: BS2 and BP2 should not be applied together per ACGS guidance.
BA1 is standalone Benign and overrides the point-based score. Other criteria are not needed.
PP3 and BP4 should not both be applied — they are opposing computational evidence.
PVS1 and PM4 should not both be applied to the same variant — PM4 overlaps with PVS1 for indels.
